generated-test.note: Held-out split of the template generator that also produced the training split. In-distribution: shares templates and topic lists with training data, so it measures template fit, not generalisation.

realistic.note: Hand-written prose, not template-generated. No overlap with training data.

adversarial.note: Hand-written cases chosen to defeat keyword matching: public docs containing credential vocabulary, internal docs that disclaim credentials, and similar traps. No overlap with training data.

reviewed-heldout.note: Independently re-annotated rows that the adapter never saw in training. This is the headline generalisation number.

reviewed-seen.note: Independently re-annotated rows drawn from boundary_training.jsonl, which IS in the LoRA training mix. Reported only as a contamination control: model scores here are memorisation, not generalisation.

policy-only.description: Regex policy layer alone, no model

tfidf-logreg.description: TF-IDF + logistic regression on the same training data

base-zero-shot.description: SmolLM2-360M-Instruct, no label definitions in the prompt

base-guided.description: SmolLM2-360M-Instruct with label definitions in the prompt

lora-policy.description: LoRA adapter + policy layer (the shipped configuration)

onnx-fp32-no-policy.description: ONNX Runtime CPU fp32, merged adapter, policy layer disabled

onnx-int8-no-policy.description: ONNX Runtime CPU dynamic INT8 (per-tensor scales), policy disabled

onnx-int8-perchannel-no-policy.description: ONNX Runtime CPU dynamic INT8 (per-channel scales), policy disabled

onnx-int8-safehead-no-policy.description: ONNX Runtime CPU dynamic INT8 with the output projection left in fp32, policy disabled
